mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic growth slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a >0.25% FEDFUNDS increase, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a >0.5% UNRATE increase, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a sustained RSAFS decline, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over two months signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth and corporate earnings are expected to improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a >2% INDPRO increase, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% over three months signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending are expected to increase.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a sustained UNRATE decrease, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% simultaneously over two months, it signals a strengthening demand and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following the joint signal, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances following the joint signal, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% and real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 0.5% over a quarter, it signals a strengthening supply side and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances following the joint signal, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
